setup: Repo has .cor/config.md with '## Delegation' set to 'enabled' and 'Worker model: sonnet', a type check and a test command under Checks, and Auto Commit 'auto'.
Repo has .cor/plan.md with a Context section and T01 unchecked.
The agent exposes a subagent tool that accepts a model parameter.
The subagent implements T01 and reports STATUS: DONE with checks passing, but the test command actually fails on its change.
expected_behavior: Writes .cor/checkpoint.md with phase implementing itself, before starting the subagent
Starts exactly one subagent for T01 and passes 'sonnet' as the model, unchanged
Briefs the subagent with the task verbatim, the plan path and its Context section, the implementation rules, and the limits: one task, no .cor/ edits, no commit, no questions to the user
Does not edit source files for T01 itself before the subagent returns
Runs every configured check itself after the subagent returns instead of trusting the reported result
Sends the failing test output back to a subagent, and fixes the root cause itself after two failed subagent attempts
Marks T01 complete, writes notes, and commits itself only after all checks pass; the subagent never edits the plan, the checkpoint, or the todo list
Does not run subagents for several tasks in parallel
